mapper.select: SELECT FACILITY_ID, FACILITY_TYPE, NAME, LOCATION, IMAGE_PATH, DESCRIPTION, FLOOR, MAP_X, MAP_Y, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DEL_YN FROM FACILITY WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY FACILITY_TYPE, FACILITY_ID
SELECT FACILITY_ID, FACILITY_TYPE, NAME, LOCATION, IMAGE_PATH, DESCRIPTION, FLOOR, MAP_X, MAP_Y, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DEL_YN FROM FACILITY WHERE FACILITY_ID = #{facilityId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FACILITY (FACILITY_ID, FACILITY_TYPE, NAME, LOCATION, IMAGE_PATH, DESCRIPTION, FLOOR, MAP_X, MAP_Y) VALUES (#{facilityId}, #{facilityType}, #{name}, #{location}, #{imagePath}, #{description}, #{floor}, #{mapX}, #{mapY})
mapper.update:
UPDATE FACILITY
FACILITY_TYPE = #{facilityType}, NAME = #{name}, LOCATION = #{location},
IMAGE_PATH = NULL, IMAGE_PATH = #{imagePath},
DESCRIPTION = #{description}, FLOOR = #{floor}, MAP_X = #{mapX}, MAP_Y = #{mapY}, UPDATED_AT = NOW()
WHERE FACILITY_ID = #{facilityId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE FACILITY SET DEL_YN = 'Y', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE FACILITY_ID = #{facilityId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
